name: Capability invocation / result
authority_boundary: L2 Cognitive Executive proposes; only authorized Control CommitGate can adopt legal state.
acceptance_preconditions: invocation/context/dependency identity valid; capability activated and budget/scope accepted; transport provenance resolves to original cognitive result.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: unactivated capability; unresolved provenance; identity or epoch mismatch; tool response pretending to be a canonical decision.
commit_and_effect_boundary: No provider or transport result is itself a canonical commit.
retry_and_recovery: Repeated or late invocation results must be fenced/deduplicated under canonical authority.
primary_source_governance: FCA §23, §48–52; RDMS-10 capability activation and executive transition bindings.
legal_mapping_rule: RDMS-10 transport list is not FCA §23 CapabilityResult; only source-bound dereference and executive/CommitGate admission can form canonical cognitive state.

name: Memory retrieval and re-use
authority_boundary: L5 owns retrieval evidence and use constraints; L2 owns cognitive incorporation; L7 conveys only.
acceptance_preconditions: scope, coverage, provenance, applicability and freshness available from legal retrieval result; access policy respected.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: short list falsely asserted exhaustive; missing coverage/freshness; access/scope mismatch; transport alias not dereferenceable.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Retrieval or ranking does not mutate belief or authorize learning.
retry_and_recovery: Replay keeps retrieval/query identity; stale results re-assessed before use.
primary_source_governance: RDMS-07 retrieval coverage/use assessment; RDMS-10 memory transport.
legal_mapping_rule: RDMS-07 result owns query, ranking, omissions, coverage, freshness; RDMS-10 return cannot overwrite this and must resolve to canonical evidence.

name: Commitment / reactivation
authority_boundary: L2 owns commitment semantics; L4 determines temporal eligibility; L1 owns legal mutation.
acceptance_preconditions: single lawful reactivation condition root and valid target identity/lifecycle; derived work durably attributable to commitment.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: legacy timestamp or trigger aliases fabricated; activation treated as satisfaction; stale or already retired commitment.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Activation and accepted derived-work obligation require canonical durable transition before downstream work.
retry_and_recovery: Idempotent processing keyed to durable source and target; no action authority from trigger.
primary_source_governance: RDMS-02 C01-32; RDMS-05 trigger-derived work; RDMS-10 C02.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Trigger firing and actions
authority_boundary: L4 evaluates conditions; L1 validates and commits durable reaction; L3 requires independent ActionGate.
acceptance_preconditions: definition snapshot/generation/qualified occurrence verified; target version and reaction are current.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: duplicate fire; obsolete target; invalid trigger generation; reaction directly dispatching an external mutation.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Reaction/target transition obey ControlCommit atomicity and durable identity.
retry_and_recovery: Reaction remains inspectable, replay-safe, and cannot be mistaken for an external effect.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Suspension / resumption
authority_boundary: L6 validates restoration and containment; L1 owns admission and epoch fencing.
acceptance_preconditions: full durable capsule payload is integrity-checked and consistent with pinned state, identity, authority, and epoch.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: truncated historical conversion; absent payload verification; stale/missing handoff or authority; fabricated field defaults.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Suspension/resumption creates no implied world rollback.
retry_and_recovery: IN_DOUBT effects reconcile before further shared-world mutation.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: External execution and journal
authority_boundary: L3 ActionGate approves exact shared-world mutation; executor cannot change effective command or scope; L1 records legal transitions.
acceptance_preconditions: authorization matches exact effective operation/arguments/target, resource versions and current policy/dependency/epoch frontier.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: unsealed or modified command; stale authority; missing durable dispatch intent; blind retry of unknown non-idempotent effect.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Persist DISPATCH_INTENT before effect. Ledger atomicity != atomic external side effect; durable Action Journal/reconciliation required.
retry_and_recovery: Mark IN_DOUBT and probe/reconcile; do not assert exactly-once without external guarantee.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Observation and evidence
authority_boundary: L3 ingests provenance and trust; L2 decides epistemic use; L1 gates legal writes.
acceptance_preconditions: source/trust context travels with observation; observed content preserved as immutable; causal attachment separately justified.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: tool self-report promoted to certainty; untrusted content granting authority; disagreement mislabeled capture corruption.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Append accepted observation and source binding; separate append from causal inference.
retry_and_recovery: Amend only capture/provenance defects with traceable amendment; keep original observation.
primary_source_governance: FCA §75–76; RDMS-03 C01 observation trust/amendment; RDMS-10 C01/C02.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Experiment and causal verification
authority_boundary: L2 owns hypothesis/causal decision; L3 performs authorized experiment and independent observation.
acceptance_preconditions: frozen design and prediction predate intervention; run/evidence attached to exact design and target.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: post-hoc prediction substituted; experiment-design state conflated with run outcome; simulated result treated as verified reality.
commit_and_effect_boundary: External experiments remain subject to ActionGate and Action Journal.
retry_and_recovery: Unknown partial intervention remains unresolved until observation/probe.
primary_source_governance: RDMS-03 experiment vs run; FCA causal hypothesis and evidence gates.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Contradiction and reality mismatch
authority_boundary: L2 controls epistemic assessment; L3 sources observations, not causal truth.
acceptance_preconditions: observations comparable in explicit scope/dimensions with traceable evidence and unresolved/resolved proof.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: UNRESOLVED silently mapped to RESOLVED; hypothesis dismissed solely due conflicting observation; causal explanation invented.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Contradiction transition needs legal state/sequence and supporting references.
retry_and_recovery: Keep prior inconsistent evidence and lifecycle history; correction must be attributable.
primary_source_governance: RDMS-03 C01 contradiction and observation rules; FCA epistemic distinctions.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Freshness and completion
authority_boundary: L4 specialist/dependency layer attests freshness; L2 judges completion; L1 adopts legal goal state.
acceptance_preconditions: dependency coverage and policy/versions attested for exact operation; completion proof matches goal acceptance contract.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: PARTIALLY_STALE treated as VALID; generic success text treated as task completion; missing dependency frontier.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Completion or focus change requires epoch/version-fenced canonical commit.
retry_and_recovery: Invalidate derived work on changed dependencies; re-evaluate at admission.
primary_source_governance: FCA §71; RDMS-06 freshness; RDMS-08 completion proof.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Learning and context egress
authority_boundary: L5 learning policy and L1/CommitGate own durable memory acceptance; L7 only transports sealed outbound content.
acceptance_preconditions: memory promotion separately authorized; outbound effective bytes/destination/context scope sealed and policy-approved.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: automatic learning from agent suggestion; sending unapproved private context; destination/payload changed after authorization.
commit_and_effect_boundary: No memory state change without canonical commit; no egress without policy admission.
retry_and_recovery: After restart, replay only scoped authorization; reject stale outbound binding.
primary_source_governance: RDMS-07 learning; RDMS-10 C01/C02 context disclosure.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.

name: Containment and recovery
authority_boundary: L6 validates containment/uncertain effects; L1 authorizes safe resumption under epoch.
acceptance_preconditions: isolation claim evidenced, uncertain effects reconciled or explicitly guarded, ownership lease valid.
mandatory_rejection_conditions: snapshot restore asserted to reverse external world; unverified isolation; old worker keeps authorization.
commit_and_effect_boundary: Canonical recovery commit fences old authority; no global rollback of external effects.
retry_and_recovery: Reconcile IN_DOUBT before new mutation; persist recovery basis and admission evidence.
legal_mapping_rule: Use source-owned contract directly; no adapter or implicit schema migration.
